name: Tooltip
summary: A short description of a control, on hover and on focus.

anatomy.description: Inverse surface; does not cover its control.

notes: Never the only place of essential information; hoverable and persistent (1.4.13).

Placement: shown as a popover (popover=hint or manual) in the top layer and linked by CSS anchor positioning (anchor-name on the control, position-anchor on the tooltip), it sits centred above the control and flips below near the top of the viewport.
